Q1_fixed_goal_spread_across_anchors.interpretation: A globally-scored goal would give ~0 std across anchors. Non-trivial per-goal spread over anchors means f depends on the anchor, i.e. the label is pair-dependent.

Q2_variance_decomposition.interpretation: goal_main_effect_frac ~ 1 would mean the critic assigns each goal a global score and the two roles WOULD conflict. Anchor + interaction mass is the pair-dependent part.

Q3_risky_vs_safe_same_failure_goals.interpretation: The SAME 16 failure goals scored by different anchors. A non-zero, CI-excluding-zero difference is direct evidence the critic already resolves the same goal differently depending on (s, a).

Q4_role_comparison.note: f_own is each anchor paired with ITS OWN frozen s_wc (the pessimistic-positive role); F is the bank goals paired with unrelated anchors (the failure-negative role).

caveat: Measured on the FROZEN Critic C, which was trained WITHOUT any pessimistic-positive branch. It shows the architecture resolves goals pair-dependently; it does not predict what training with the branch would do.
